extracted.intended_audience: small business and academic investigators preparing an NIH SBIR/STTR (PA-12-089) application (PD/PIs, institutional grant administrators)
extracted.subtask_description: A sample PHS 398 / SF424 (R&R) SBIR/STTR grant application demonstrating the required application components, attachments, and institutional/resource descriptions for PA-12-089. It shows required sections, biosketch format constraints, facilities/equipment reporting, human/animal protections, and data/resource sharing statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Follow FOA/application-format instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Always follow your funding opportunity's instructions for application format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Samples may not reflect latest format or rules; check the FOA and program-specific instructions. NIAID posts new samples periodically: https://www.niaid.nih.gov/grants-contracts/sample-applications

rubrics_metrics.name: SF 424 (R&R) Face Page / Required Applicant Identifiers
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Type of Submission, Federal Identifier, Applicant Information (DUNS, Legal Name, Address), Employer Identification (EIN/TIN), Type of Applicant, and certifications/assurances with authorized representative signature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include organizational DUNS, EIN/TIN, congressional district, project start/ending dates, and complete contact information for the PD/PI and authorized institutional official. Certify truthfulness and compliance per U.S. Code Title 18 Section 1001.

rubrics_metrics.name: Performance Sites
rubrics_metrics.description: List all Project/Performance Site Location(s) with organization name, street address, congressional district, and DUNS for each site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include primary and additional locations (e.g., small business site and academic partner site). Indicate project performance site congressional district and ensure DUNS/organizational identifiers are present.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Summary / Abstract (Description)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a concise Project Summary/Abstract describing the problem, significance, and the proposed specific Aims (e.g., Aim 1, Aim 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summarize state-of-the-art background, expected impact (e.g., induction of donor-specific immunological tolerance), model systems, and the planned Phase I proof-of-concept aims and next-stage plans for clinical translation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public Health Relevance Statement (Project Narrative)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a plain-language Project Narrative describing the relevance of the proposed work to public health.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how the project could improve clinical outcomes (e.g., long-term outcome of organ transplantation), potential patient populations, translational pathway and intended clinical development or commercialization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan: Specific Aims
rubrics_metrics.description: Include a 'Specific Aims' section that clearly states the objectives and hypotheses to be tested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aims should be concrete and feasible for the award period and align with the Project Summary and Research Strategy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Plan: Research Strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Research Strategy describing significance, innovation, and approach for the proposed work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include experimental design, methods, preliminary data where appropriate, and how results will inform next stages (e.g., design of clinical trials).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research & Related Senior/Key Person Information and Biographical Sketches
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide profiles and biographical sketches for key personnel using the required format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: BIOGRAPHICAL SKETCH: "DO NOT EXCEED FOUR PAGES." Include Personal Statement, Positions and Honors, Education/Training, Selected Peer-reviewed Publications, and other required subsections. Attach Current & Pending Support as directed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Facilities & Other Resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Describe facilities and resources available at each performance site (laboratory, vivarium, offices, clinical labs, computer resources, library, interactions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide specific details: square footage, number/type of labs, biosafety cabinets, incubators, vivarium capacity, animal procedure rooms, autoclaves, GMP clean rooms, backup generators, monitoring, access to core facilities, accreditation and certifications (e.g., CAP, CLIA, AAALAC), major shared equipment and support services, computing/network resources, and institutional interactions that support the project.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment
rubrics_metrics.description: List major equipment available to support the proposed work and note maintenance/calibration procedures.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include specific instruments (e.g., flow cytometers, cell sorters, bioreactors, irradiators, ultra-low freezers, automated cell isolators), quantities, relevant performance (e.g., irradiator output), and note preventive maintenance, calibration, and data archival/back-up practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vertebrate Animals
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicate whether vertebrate animals are used and provide IACUC approval date and Animal Welfare Assurance Number when applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If YES, provide justification, species/strains, numbers, animal facility descriptions, IACUC status (approved/pending), and compliance details. Provide environmental impact/exemption information if relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Human Subjects and Clinical Trial Involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: State whether human subjects are involved, include IRB Approval Date and Human Subject Assurance Number, and indicate if the project is exempt.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If human subjects are involved, provide IRB documentation, protections, and any exemption rationale. Indicate whether a clinical trial is planned or not.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select Agent Research Declaration
rubrics_metrics.description: Declare whether the project involves select agents or toxins and provide required descriptions if applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If select agents are involved, follow institutional and federal reporting and containment requirements and provide attachments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple PI Leadership Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a leadership plan when multiple PIs are proposed, outlining roles and governance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe decision-making, communication, and allocation of responsibilities among PIs/MPI team members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Budget and Budget Justification
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide Research & Related Budgets for Year 1, cumulative budgets, consortium budgets, and a Budget Justification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Detail direct costs, indirect costs (F&A), personnel effort, subawards, equipment, animal costs, and clearly justify requested funds. Include SBIR/STTR-specific budget sections where applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Consortium/Contractual Arrangements
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide documentation and budget details for any consortium or subcontractual relationships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include subaward budgets, scope of work, letters of support/commitment, and institutional approvals for each subcontractor or collaborating organization.

rubrics_metrics.name: Resource/Data Sharing Plan
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a Data Sharing Plan and statements on sharing model organisms and GWAS policy as required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note that per the SF424 (R&R) SBIR/STTR Application Guide a formal Data Sharing plan may not be required if requested direct costs are under the funding agency's threshold; still state how data will be shared (e.g., publications, presentations). For model organisms, declare if new organisms will be generated; for GWAS, state whether GWAS are planned.

rubrics_metrics.name: PHS 398 Checklist items (Inventions/Patents, Program Income, Disclosure Permission)
rubrics_metrics.description: Answer PHS 398 Checklist questions including Inventions and Patents (for renewals), anticipated Program Income, and Disclosure Permission statements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide details when 'Yes' is selected (e.g., list inventions/patents for renewals), complete program income tables if applicable, and indicate whether the government may disclose applicant contact info if application is not awarded.

rubrics_metrics.name: SBIR/STTR Information and FOA-specific sections
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete SBIR/STTR-specific information required by the FOA (e.g., organizational eligibility, commercialization plan elements, SBIR/STTR attachments).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow PA-12-089 FOA instructions for required SBIR/STTR attachments such as company information, commercialization strategy, and other small business-specific certifications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Bibliography & References Cited
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a comprehensive Bibliography & References Cited section for prior work and supporting literature.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cite relevant peer-reviewed literature that supports the rationale, preliminary data, and feasibility of the project; include key translational/clinical references when relevant.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format constraints and accessibility/FOIA notices
rubrics_metrics.description: Observe page limits, format constraints, copyright, FOIA, and Section 508 accessibility notes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Respect explicit page limits (e.g., biosketch page limit), indicate permission terms for posted sample applications, and be aware that NIH will redact sensitive information in FOIA responses; ensure electronic submissions conform to accessibility guidance.
